# FG-GIT-0030

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `content_with_a_nul_is_not_text` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: ファイルにテキストでない内容（NUL 文字）が含まれているため、エディターでは保存できません。
- en: The file contains non-text content (a NUL character), so it cannot be saved from the editor.
- id: File berisi konten non-teks (karakter NUL), sehingga tidak dapat disimpan dari editor.

## 原因 (cause)

The `content` of a single-file commit (the simple editor) holds a NUL character (`\u0000` in the JSON): git and the browse API treat such a file as binary. The editor writes UTF-8 text only (the JSON body is UTF-8 by construction). Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `reason=nul`, `project_id`, `repo_id`, `route=single_file_commit`.

## 対処 (fix)

Remove the NUL characters, or push the binary file with git.
